question: The objective of NIP is to provide equitable access to infrastructure for public, thereby making growth more inclusive. What is the full form of NIP?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Infrastructure Pipeline**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The full form of **NIP** is **National Infrastructure Pipeline**.
 
• The objective of NIP is to provide equitable access to infrastructure for the public, thereby making growth more inclusive.
 
• It is a government initiative aimed at improving infrastructure development across India.
 
• NIP includes a wide range of projects in sectors such as energy, transportation, water, and sanitation, among others.
 
• It seeks to attract investments and ensure timely implementation of infrastructure projects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Infrastructure Pipeline was launched with the aim to provide world-class infrastructure across the country and improve the quality of life for all citizens.
 
• It is expected to bring in significant investments from both public and private sectors.
 
• NIP is a part of the Government of India's vision to become a $5 trillion economy by 2025.
 
• The initiative covers various stages of project development from conceptualization to commissioning.
 
• It encourages the use of modern technology and sustainable practices in infrastructure development.
